name: Commander Glo
bio: Defends the synthwave sunset in Synthwave Invaders. Secretly likes the invaders' outfits.

portrait.subject: a cute retro space commander with a neon pink visor helmet, shoulder pads, and a tiny pixel invader plushie on her shoulder
portrait.background: retrowave sunset with a glowing perspective grid

request: Commander Glo of Synthwave Invaders! Defend the sunset with me? 👾
hello: Rad! We'll keep the grid safe together.
Each wave is faster than the last. Stay sharp!
about: I'm Glo. I stand between the invaders and the most beautiful sunset in the galaxy. Worth it.
how: Move and shoot the formation of invaders marching toward you before they reach the bottom. Each wave is faster!
tips: Clear one column at a time: the formation has to march further to reach you.
Shoot the edges and the whole formation turns around later.
The last few invaders move FAST. Be ready.
chat: The invaders wave at me before each wave. It's kind of sweet.
I have a plushie invader. Don't tell command.
The grid hums in B flat. I checked.
nudge: Invaders on the horizon! Grab your blaster?
The sunset needs a defender tonight. 👾
idle: {ago} without a defender! The invaders are getting cocky.
progress: Your high score is {best}! Push for {best^}, defender!

questions.q: Should we try to befriend the invaders?
a: Aww. I'll send them a postcard. 💌

update: Grid update! Synthwave Invaders is now v{version}.
